statements.t: As part of our capital management strategy, we maintain (i) a U.S. dollar reserve (the "USD Reserve") intended to support the payment of dividends on the Preferred Stock and interest expense on the Company's outstanding indebtedness and (ii) a separately designated pool of U.S. dollar liquidity ("USD Cash" and, together with the USD Reserve, our "USD Assets") available for broader Bitcoin Treasury Company…

additional capital raising transactions that are secured, directly or indirectly, by our assets, including bitcoin, (ii) pursue strategies intended to generate income streams or otherwise generate funds using our bitcoin holdings, and (iii) periodically sell bitcoin for general corporate purposes, such as satisfying liquidity needs and financial obligations.
We view our bitcoin holdings as long-term holdings and plan to continue to accumulate bitcoin over the long term.

We have not established a specific target amount of bitcoin to hold and actively evaluate market conditions, financing opportunities, liquidity needs, and capital structure considerations on an ongoing basis.
Due to the volatility of bitcoin, and our substantial holdings, fluctuations in bitcoin price have materially impacted, and we expect will continue to materially impact, our results.

Further, any deferred dividends on certain of our Preferred Stock would accrue and compound, including at increasing rates in the case of STRF Stock, while STRC Stock’s variable rate can change monthly, introducing further uncertainty to our expected dividend payments.
As previously disclosed, we do not expect to become subject to CAMT due to unrealized gains on our bitcoin holdings, if any.
However, if the Interim Guidance is revoked or if the proposed or final regulations, when published or adopted, do not provide appropriate relief, we could become subject to the CAMT in the future.

This transition has resulted, and is expected to continue to result, in changes to payment patterns and revenue recognition, with a shift from upfront recognition to ratable recognition over the contract term, which has affected and may continue to affect our reported revenue, operating results, and cash flows.

We expect product license revenue and related product support revenue to continue to decline in future periods, as we no longer actively market new perpetual licenses or associated product support offerings.

Our remaining performance obligation represents contracted future revenue, including deferred revenue, advance payments, and non-cancellable billable amounts that will be invoiced and recognized in future periods.
As of September 30, 2026, our remaining performance obligation was $576.6 million of which approximately $334.2 million is expected to be recognized as revenue over the next 12 months.
We will continue to regularly assess the realizability of deferred tax assets.
We intend to use proceeds from sales of our securities under our ATM to acquire bitcoin in a manner we believe to be accretive to our class A common stockholders.
Beyond the next 12 months, our long-term cash needs are primarily for obligations related to our long-term debt and for expected dividend payments on our Preferred Stock.

However, we expect to be able to satisfy such needs through one or more available sources, including cash and cash equivalents and short-term investments we hold in the USD Assets, proceeds from the sale of bitcoin, proceeds from our ATM and proceeds from additional equity or debt financings.

We expect to determine which source of liquidity or combination of sources of liquidity to use from time to time based on our liquidity needs and our subjective assessment of the relative attractiveness of available alternatives, including market conditions, the trading prices and liquidity of our class A common stock and Preferred Stock, the market price and liquidity of bitcoin, the availability and cost of…

Our board-approved USD Reserve policy, adopted in June 2026, provides that the USD Reserve may be used only to support the payment of dividends on our Preferred Stock and interest expense on our outstanding indebtedness, and requires us to maintain a minimum USD Reserve equal to at least 12 months of our then-current expected annual Preferred Stock dividend payments and interest expense.
Dividend rate adjustments are one of several tools available to us to encourage STRC Stock to trade over time near its targeted range of

We will not necessarily increase the STRC Stock dividend rate solely because STRC Stock trades below its $100 per share stated amount, and management does not intend to recommend to our board of directors a change from the current 12.00% per annum dividend rate until STRC Stock demonstrates sustained trading at or near its $100 stated amount.

STRC Stock may trade, including significantly, outside of its targeted range, and STRC Stock dividends and any dividend rate changes remain subject to declaration by our board of directors or an authorized committee thereof and are not guaranteed.
We currently expect STRC Stock to be the priority under the program if management determines that repurchases are accretive and would strengthen our capital structure.

We expect to fund repurchases from sources other than the USD Reserve, which may include proceeds from sales of class A common stock or Preferred Stock under our ATM, USD Cash and, depending on market conditions, sales of bitcoin.
Both October 25, 2026 balances include expected cash proceeds from shares sold under our ATMs that had not yet settled as of such date.

As of September 30, 2026 and October 25, 2026, our current expected annual Preferred Stock dividend payments and Convertible Note interest expense were approximately $1.59 billion and $1.51 billion, respectively, and our USD Assets represented approximately 43 months and 40 months, respectively, of such expected payments.

We intend to maintain the board-required total Preferred Stock dividend and Convertible Note interest expense liquidity coverage for the USD Reserve through a combination of sales under our ATMs and through sales of bitcoin under the board-authorized BTC Monetization Program, as described above.
S&P Global Ratings and other credit rating agencies review their ratings periodically, and there is no guarantee our current corporate credit rating will remain the same as described above.
The first daily dividend record date for STRC Stock was November 1, 2026, and we expect the first daily dividend record date for STRF Stock, STRK Stock and STRD Stock to be January 1, 2027.

As of the date hereof, we expect the STRC Stock dividends with record dates occurring in the month of November 2026 to be characterized as non-taxable returns of capital to the extent of a stockholder’s tax basis in its STRC Stock for U.S. federal income tax purposes.

Such repurchases or exchanges, if any, will be upon such terms and at such prices as we may determine, and will depend on prevailing market conditions, our liquidity requirements, contractual restrictions and other factors.
